blind.description: A square, woven wicker basket filled with colorful rolled cloth or fabric bolts standing vertically. The stylized basket has thick woven bands in a warm brown color. Inside, rolled textiles are tightly bundled, showing rolled swirl tops in a variety of colors including cream, orange, maroon, lime green, dark green, lavender, and blue. Surfaces are smooth and continuous with stylized chunky details.
blind.from_above: A rounded square woven basket rim enclosing a tight cluster of circular spiral-topped rolls of fabric in multiple pastel and jewel-tone colors.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.8 to 2 feet tall) and roughly 1.8 feet wide.
